chatrix.branding.author: by Hristrix
chatrix.config.title: Chatrix
chatrix.config.hint_default: Hover a setting to see its description
chatrix.config.chance_for_spawn.desc: Chance for a message to spawn
chatrix.config.message_history_max.desc: Maximum number of messages kept in history
How long messages stay visible (in seconds)
chatrix.config.message_fall_seconds.desc: How long messages take to fall (in seconds)
chatrix.config.display_mode.desc: In the world as 3D bubbles, or as a HUD overlay. Position and 3D options are on the Placement tab.
chatrix.config.world_placement.desc: Around you in a radius, or FOP only — only in the player's field of view.
chatrix.config.role_filter.desc: If every role toggle is off, all messages are shown. Turn on one or more roles to keep only those authors (OR). Works on Twitch, YouTube, Kick, and TikTok.
chatrix.config.role_filter_subs.desc: Keep subscriber/member messages of this source. If subscriber, VIP and mod are all off, everyone is shown.
chatrix.config.role_filter_vip.desc: Keep VIP messages of this source. Can be combined with subscribers and/or mods.
chatrix.config.role_filter_mods.desc: Keep moderator and broadcaster messages of this source. Can be combined with subscribers and/or VIP.
chatrix.config.hud_anchor.desc: Which screen corner the overlay sits in.
chatrix.config.hud_offset_x.desc: Extra horizontal inset from the chosen HUD corner, in pixels (0–400).
chatrix.config.hud_offset_y.desc: Extra vertical inset from the chosen HUD corner, in pixels (0–400).
chatrix.config.platform_card.desc: Toggle the platform on/off, or open its settings with the gear button.
chatrix.config.platform_enabled.desc: Add this source to the parsed list. Messages arrive once the chat parser is started (Chat ON).
chatrix.config.platform_show_messages.de: Mute this platform without disconnecting: its messages stay hidden.
chatrix.config.platform_message_sound.de: Play the new message sound for this platform.
chatrix.config.tiktok_gift_events.desc: Show TikTok gifts as chat messages.
chatrix.config.tiktok_follow_events.desc: Show new TikTok followers as chat messages.
chatrix.config.panel_base_color.desc: Tint of message_panel.png. Default is black (000000).
chatrix.config.panel_border_from_platfor: Use the platform's brand color for the panel border. Turn off to pick your own.
chatrix.config.panel_border_color.desc: Panel border color, 6 hex digits. Used when 'Border by platform' is off.
chatrix.config.show_role_badges.desc: Show host/mod/VIP/subscriber badges next to the author's name.
chatrix.config.username_blocklist.desc: Ignore messages from blocked usernames. The gear button opens the list.
chatrix.blocked_users.title: Manage Blocked Usernames
chatrix.banwords.title: Manage Banwords
chatrix.regexps.title: Manage Banwords
chatrix.config.youtube_enabled.desc: Include YouTube live chat when connecting
chatrix.config.youtube_channel.desc: YouTube @handle, video URL, or 11-char video ID while live. Use ON/OFF on the right to include this platform.
chatrix.config.kick_channel.desc: Kick channel slug from kick.com/username. Use ON/OFF on the right to include this platform.
chatrix.config.tiktok_enabled.desc: Include TikTok live chat when connecting
chatrix.config.tiktok_username.desc: TikTok @username while live. Use ON/OFF on the right to include this platform.
chatrix.config.chat_connection.desc: Connect or disconnect all enabled platforms (same as the hotkey)
chatrix.chat.no_platforms: No platforms enabled. Turn on at least one platform in settings.
chatrix.chat.not_connected: Not connected to any chat platform.
chatrix.chat.error.no_live_room: %s: no live stream found for '%s' (wrong name or stream is offline)
chatrix.chat.error.blocked: %s: request was blocked by the platform, retrying...
chatrix.config.channel_name.desc: Twitch channel name. Use ON/OFF on the right to include this platform when connecting.
chatrix.config.automoderation.desc: Filter messages by banned words. The gear button opens the banwords list.
chatrix.config.message_sound.desc: Play a notification sound when a new chat message appears
chatrix.config.message_sound_volume.desc: Volume of the new message notification sound
chatrix.config.auto_connect_irc.desc: Automatically connect to enabled chat platforms when entering a world/server
chatrix.config.message_lifetime.desc: How long messages stay visible (in ticks)
chatrix.config.message_fall.desc: How long messages take to fall (in ticks)
chatrix.config.message_scale.desc: Size of 3D messages in the world. 100% is the former “Normal” size
chatrix.config.hud_scale.desc: Size of message cards in the HUD widget. 100% is the former “Normal” size
chatrix.config.message_wrap_width.desc: How wide a line can get before the text wraps. Applies to world messages and the HUD widget
chatrix.config.spawn_mode.desc: In the world as 3D bubbles, or as a HUD overlay
chatrix.config.spawn_min_distance.desc: Closest horizontal distance from you, in blocks
chatrix.config.spawn_max_distance.desc: Farthest horizontal distance from you, in blocks
chatrix.config.freezing_on_view.desc: Freeze messages when looking at them
chatrix.config.max_freeze_distance.desc: Maximum distance for message freezing (in blocks)
chatrix.config.show_message_bg.desc: Show semi-transparent background behind message text
chatrix.config.color_emojis.desc: Render Unicode emojis with the system emoji font instead of the Minecraft font
chatrix.config.follow_player.desc: 3D messages smoothly follow the player, keeping their original relative offset
chatrix.config.click_to_remove.desc: Left-click on messages to remove them instantly with particles
chatrix.config.unpin_mode.desc: How to unpin a pinned 3D message with right-click. Whole message: quick click unpins, holding drags
chatrix.history.title: Chat History
chatrix.history.pinned_empty: No pinned messages. Pin a message in the world or from history to see it here.
chatrix.history.empty: No messages yet. Connect to Twitch chat to see messages here.
chatrix.history.scroll_hint: Scroll · Click a message for actions
chatrix.history.click_for_actions: Click for pin, block, or replay
chatrix.config.role_filter_all.desc: When on, every chat message is shown and the role toggles below are ignored. Turn off to keep only selected roles.
chatrix.config.role_filter.twitch.subs.d: Twitch subscribers and founders. Used only when “Show everyone” is off.
chatrix.config.role_filter.twitch.vip.de: Twitch VIP badge. Used only when “Show everyone” is off.
chatrix.config.role_filter.twitch.mods.d: Twitch moderators and the broadcaster. Used only when “Show everyone” is off.
YouTube channel members. Live chat does not expose free subscribers or followers.
YouTube moderators and the channel owner.
chatrix.config.role_filter.kick.subs.des: Kick subscribers, OG and founder badges.
chatrix.config.role_filter.kick.mods.des: Kick moderators and the channel host.
chatrix.config.role_filter.tiktok.follow: Viewers who follow this TikTok LIVE (follow status on the chat user).
chatrix.config.role_filter.tiktok.subs.d: TikTok LIVE subscribers (paid sub / fan club badges).
chatrix.config.role_filter.tiktok.mods.d: TikTok LIVE moderators and the host.
chatrix.config.reset_defaults.desc: Restore every setting on this screen to factory defaults. Channel names, banwords, blocked names and regexps are kept.
chatrix.config.color_picker.title: Choose color
chatrix.editor.title: Message editor
chatrix.editor.desc: Visual editor: adjust size, width and colors while watching sample messages live in the world.
chatrix.editor.desc_no_world: Join a world to open the visual message editor.
chatrix.editor.no_world: Join a world to see the preview
chatrix.editor.hint.message: Drag — rotate · Scroll — camera distance · RMB — reset
chatrix.editor.hint.hud: The preview is shown in the HUD corner
chatrix.editor.sample_text.twitch: Hi chat! Is this the new base? PogChamp
chatrix.editor.sample_text.youtube: This build is amazing, how long did it take to make all those redstone doors?
chatrix.editor.sample_text.tiktok: Watch out, a creeper is behind you!
chatrix.config.twitch_connect.desc: Channel name, or the primary stream key from Twitch Creator Dashboard. The key is resolved to your channel automatically.
chatrix.config.stream_key.invalid: This stream key could not be resolved.
chatrix.config.stream_key.twitch.desc: Primary stream key from Twitch Creator Dashboard. The mod finds your channel from it.
